surfaces.userSafeDescription: The web workspace shell is present and running as a demo surface.
The plan canvas supports the current interactive drawing workflow.
Edits are journaled locally for recovery. This does not itself prove that a portable .arq project file was written.
Native .arq and OPFS capabilities exist in library and worker code, but the browser open-project pipeline is not established as a current product flow.
The current file flow can classify a compatible project as safe to open. It does not establish that the project is now open.
The 3D tab is reachable in the running app and renders the model with plan-shared selection, verified by a headless-browser capability check; it is a viewing surface, not a 3D authoring feature.
Import and export capability exists in code, without an evidenced end-to-end product flow.
Sync and collaboration are not current product capabilities.
The public marketing site is a static Pages deployment and needs source and deployed-claim proof.
Zeus 4.0 is useful local advisory tooling. It is not the branch-protection authority.
Arq Language System 4.1 governs public vocabulary and claims; its checks gate CI and every Pages deployment.
